name: Snow / One drop
look: Bare ink trees and stick figures in an overexposed white, snow on ones, one red drop for the whole film; plate B is the negative of the same frame, the drop still red

axes.base: snow overexposure: a white that eats the ground and the foot of every trunk, fog grey only at the top of the sky
axes.line: crow ink through inkPath with pressure and taper on trunks, limbs and scarves; twigs as hairlines
axes.tone: stipple snow: a fine ink speckle over the whole frame, boiling on 12; no hatching, no fill but the drop
axes.planB: the negative: the scene draws the same frame with every colour inverted except the drop, which stays red
axes.motion: weightless 24: snow and the drop fall on ones, figures hold poses on twos, lines boil on 12
axes.accent: one red drop for the whole film
axes.font: thin hand capitals: strokeText hand, upright, a hairline weight
axes.match: silhouette: the figure keeps its outline and place across the cut to the negative
